collections.description: Artificial life, ecosystems, physics, procedural systems, cellular automata, and scientific simulation.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude general graphics or numerical tools without a reviewed simulation use.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when simulation of natural or emergent behavior is an evidenced central role.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for software that models natural, physical, or emergent systems.
collections.title: Computational Nature & Simulation

collections.description: Image and video understanding, geometry, perception, and vision-language systems.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic model tooling without a reviewed visual or multimodal use.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when image, video, geometry, or vision-language work is an evidenced primary role.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for reviewed visual perception and multimodal systems.
collections.title: Computer Vision & Multimodal

collections.description: Foundation-model tooling, inference, RAG, agents, evaluation, context, and multimodal generation.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude hype-only discovery signals and repositories without evidence for a named need.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it directly supports a named model, retrieval, agent, context, or evaluation need.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for reviewed generative-AI and agent-system components and references.
collections.title: Generative AI & Agents

collections.description: Local infrastructure, private cloud, networking, storage, media, and operations at home.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic cloud, CI, or developer tooling without a specific self-hosting role.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when operating a homelab or self-hosted service is one of its evidenced primary uses.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for software used to run personally operated infrastructure.
collections.title: Homelab & Self-Hosting

collections.description: Native surfaces, catalogs, decision records, and presentation tools considered for evidence-backed OSS curation.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude unreviewed discovery results and components without a documented decision effect.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it is used by, evaluated for, or materially informs ShouldaUsedThat's curation workflow.
collections.semantics: The product-specific collection showing the components and prior art behind ShouldaUsedThat.
collections.title: OSS Curation Foundations

collections.description: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, developer platforms, release engineering, observability, and operations.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic libraries without a reviewed platform or delivery role.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it has an evidenced delivery, platform, release, or operations role.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for building, securing, releasing, and operating software platforms.
collections.title: Platform Engineering & Delivery

collections.description: Runtime libraries and development tools used to build and test dependable Python software.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude language-adjacent repositories without a concrete Python role.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when this project uses or recommends it for a named Python engineering need.
collections.semantics: A cross-cutting necessity collection for evidenced Python implementation roles.
collections.title: Python Engineering

collections.description: Testing, security analysis, dependency evidence, packaging, provenance, and release integrity.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic security branding without a bounded control used or evaluated here.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it supplies a named test, security, packaging, or provenance control.
collections.semantics: A cross-cutting necessity collection for evidenced software integrity controls.
collections.title: Software Supply Chain

description: The public, evidence-bound catalog of OSS used, trialed, referenced, watched, rejected, or built by ShouldaUsedThat.

excluded_candidates.reason: Direct unstar and backup behavior exceed the additive-only mutation boundary.

non_ranking_disclaimer: This catalog records evidence-bound decisions for named needs and does not claim a universal best-OSS ranking.
popularity_treatment: Popularity is a time-stamped discovery signal only; it never proves suitability, safety, or project fit.

attribution_obligations: MIT attribution applies to upstream guidance; no upstream text is copied into runtime code.
records.description: Open development guidance and reusable skills for agent-assisted engineering.
records.need: Selective context and source-driven development guidance.
records.rationale: Two complete MIT-licensed skills are pinned as guidance and are not runtime dependencies.
records.reconsideration_trigger: A later pinned revision is fully reviewed and materially improves the workflow.

records.description: Desktop application for browsing, searching, and organizing GitHub stars.
records.need: Learn from mature star search and organization without inheriting its runtime boundary.
records.rationale: The interface is useful prior art; credential, provider, plugin, and release-provenance concerns keep it out of the runtime.
records.reconsideration_trigger: Credential storage, outbound boundaries, and verifiable release provenance are independently resolved.

records.description: Fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.
records.need: One reproducible Python environment and lock owner.
records.rationale: uv owns the environment and lock without layering Poetry, tox, or Nox.
records.reconsideration_trigger: The lock or cross-platform execution contract stops being reproducible.

attribution_obligations: Preserve CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution for derived catalog content.
records.description: Curated best-of lists backed by structured project metadata.
records.need: Human-curated public seeds and refreshed metadata without treating rank as fit.
records.rationale: Published data is useful provenance; generic score and presence never prove suitability.
records.reconsideration_trigger: License, published data shape, or attribution terms change.

records.description: Generator and updater used by best-of list projects.
records.need: Avoid a generator that can turn enrichment failure into candidate disappearance.
records.rationale: GPL and content boundaries plus observed last-known-good failures make embedding unjustified.
records.reconsideration_trigger: License documentation and fail-closed last-known-good behavior are resolved upstream.

records.description: Dashboard for exploring and organizing GitHub stars.
records.need: Keep the local-first curation core free of a hosted backend and analytics surface.
records.rationale: Supabase, provider, telemetry, and direct mutation surfaces are disproportionate to this release.
records.reconsideration_trigger: A local static boundary with no direct mutation or analytics becomes the default.

records.description: Static dashboard experiment for organizing starred repositories.
records.need: Watch a lightweight public catalog approach without adopting an immature contract.
records.rationale: The static approach is relevant, but stable releases and an auditable export contract are not yet established.
records.reconsideration_trigger: A stable release and documented deterministic export contract exist.

records.description: GitHub Action for initializing, building, and analyzing projects with CodeQL.
records.need: Repository-native source analysis with SARIF evidence.
records.rationale: CodeQL supplies hosted source analysis while other tools retain separate dependency and workflow roles.
records.reconsideration_trigger: GitHub changes the supported action or the selected SHA is no longer valid.

records.description: Python implementation of the JMESPath query language for JSON documents.
records.need: Safe local expressions over a documented candidate view.
records.rationale: JMESPath avoids a custom DSL or arbitrary Python evaluation.
records.reconsideration_trigger: A required real-world filter cannot be expressed safely.

records.description: Composable Python package for creating command-line interfaces.
records.need: A mature direct command and option boundary without a custom parser.
records.rationale: Click owns parsing and help while typed domain validation stays in ShouldaUsedThat.
records.reconsideration_trigger: The selected major version becomes incompatible or an already-used component fully owns parsing.

records.description: Evidence-bound coordinator for discovering, evaluating, and revisiting OSS choices.
records.need: Own the residual project plus need plus evidence plus decision plus freshness relationship.
records.rationale: Existing systems remain authoritative for transport, inventory, discovery, security, and rendering; the small cross-context receipt layer remains unique.
records.reconsideration_trigger: An established component supplies the complete residual under the same privacy and mutation guarantees.

records.description: Data validation and settings management using Python type annotations.
records.need: Strict versioned records and generated JSON Schema.
records.rationale: Pydantic validates external records while workflow rules remain explicit services.
records.reconsideration_trigger: A major version breaks the strict immutable record boundary.

records.description: Python testing framework for readable tests, fixtures, and plugins.
records.need: Readable scenario and contract tests across supported Python versions.
records.rationale: pytest is the single test runner; property and coverage tools have distinct roles.
records.reconsideration_trigger: Supported Python compatibility or plugin behavior becomes unsuitable.

records.description: Python implementation of the RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme.
records.need: Interoperable content identity for immutable receipts.
records.rationale: A standards implementation avoids incomplete sorted-JSON identity rules.
records.reconsideration_trigger: Published RFC vectors fail or compatibility changes.

records.description: Static site generator for modern, searchable project documentation.
records.need: Responsive Markdown rendering, tags, and private client-side search without a custom frontend.
records.rationale: The exact pre-1.0 version is removable and must prove deterministic, accessible, no-runtime-network output.
records.reconsideration_trigger: Strict build, search, accessibility, or no-third-party-request validation fails.

source_provenance.source: GitHub immutable release and public decision receipt

title: ShouldaUsedThat OSS Curation
